description: This file defines an interface for monitoring block pool metrics and a class that bridges object pool metrics to block pool metrics within the Orleans cache infrastructure.

classes.name: ObjectPoolMonitorBridge
classes.description: A class that bridges object pool metrics to block pool metrics, implementing IObjectPoolMonitor and delegating calls to an IBlockPoolMonitor instance.

methods.name: ObjectPoolMonitorBridge
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the bridge with a block pool monitor and block size in bytes.

methods.name: TrackObjectAllocated
methods.description: Increments the memory allocated metric by the block size.

methods.name: TrackObjectReleased
methods.description: Decrements the memory in use by reporting the release of a block of size.

methods.name: Report
methods.description: Reports the total, available, and claimed memory in bytes based on object counts and block size.
